title: diphasiastrum tristachyum
intro: Diphasiastrum tristachyum, commonly known as the three-staked forked polypody, is a type of fern that belongs to the Lycopodiaceae family. It is a vascular plant that grows in shaded areas, typically found in North America and Asia. The health benefits of Diphasiastrum tristachyum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which can help to reduce pain, inflammation, and improve overall health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, lignans, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
